page.overview:
Who is Bigger Brothers clerk?

The Bigger Brothers clerk is an employee of the Bigger Brothers Agency. She allows Bart Simpson to take part in the organization when he pretends to be impoverished. She later signs Homer Simpson up to be a father figure for the agency, and accepts "revenge" as his reason for wanting to sign up.
